fields.summary: TC-780-01: Current Override Credits Populated in COA Record After Audit Processing

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-780

Precondition: A trip with LCO, LRO, or RRO override conditions has completed the Phase 2 audit. The current override credit values (LCO credit, LRO credit, RRO credit) must be added to the COA record in DynamoDB.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip with an involuntary leg change (isOriginal=false) that qualifies for LCO override credit
Trip with non-original paying leg: lcoCode=P, lcoCredit to be calculated by audit
Trip is set up and ready for Phase 2 audit processing
Trigger the Phase 2 pay audit workflow and allow it to complete
Phase 2 Step Function with COA_CSS_PHASE_2_TOGGLE=TRUE, auditNeeded=true, trip release time passed
Phase 2 audit workflow completes with auditStatus=Completed
Verify the current override credit fields (lcoCredit, lroCredit, rroCredit) are populated in the DynamoDB COA record
DynamoDB crew-qa2-techp-cmn-coatable record for the audited trip
DynamoDB record contains non-null lcoCredit, lroCredit, rroCredit fields reflecting the calculated override amounts
Verify the override credit values match the expected calculated amounts based on the trip's LCO, LRO, and RRO conditions
Expected lcoCredit based on flight credit difference for non-original legs
Override credit values in DynamoDB match the expected calculated amounts for LCO, LRO, and RRO respectively
Verify the COA Search App and Analytical Schema expose the current override credits correctly for auditor review
COA Search App and Analytical Schema queried for the audited trip
COA Search App and Analytical Schema display lcoCredit, lroCredit, and rroCredit with correct non-zero values for the applicable overrides
